jobs.title: Entry Level Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

PAE is an engineering and design firm that turns complex challenges into reality. By leveraging the latest technologies, we solve problems in unique ways, and our designs enable buildings and communities to be more resilient and efficient. PAE is trusted by our clients in every aspect of a project's lifespan, from idea to occupancy. We set ambitious goals backed by analysis to significantly conserve water and energy while balancing costs and long-term operational needs. As a B Corp, we measure success by the benefits our projects provide to our clients, our communities, and our planet. We embrace innovation, transparency, sustainability, and lifelong curiosity.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop relationships with project teams for effective communication
* Prepare project deliverables with attention to detail
* Develop knowledge of the construction industry
* Provide quality control for project documents for formatting, proofreading, and conformance with PAE's graphical standards
* Develop ability to facilitate construction administration activities
* Track deadlines, action items, RFIs, submittals
* Assist with project documentation, meeting setup and deliverables
* Utilize tools within the project quality management plan (QMP)

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or equivalent experience
* Experience in an administrative role ideally with an engineering firm or other subcontractor preferred
* Team player
* Reliable and flexible in style of work and able to maintain a positive attitude
* Strong written, verbal, interpersonal communication, and organizational skills
* Ability to multitask and switch between tasks
* Power user of Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience with Database Programs

**What We Offer**

* Hiring Base Salary Range: $55,300-$66,100 annual

  + This position is eligible for time and a half overtime pay

The base salary is one component of PAE’s competitive compensation package for employees. We take into consideration a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, abilities, experience, education, credentials, internal equity and geographic location in determining exact salary offered. At PAE, employees are eligible for annual compensation reviews based on performance and business needs. The above range represents PAE's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.

**In addition, PAE offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes the following:**

* Employer paid health insurance (medical, dental, vision)
* Annual 401k profit sharing based on company profit for the year and account contribution
* Professional development reimbursements including state registration and professional association dues
* Employer paid commuter/parking stipend
* Cell phone stipend
* Life insurance and disability benefits
* Hybrid work schedule
* Employee Assistance Program
* 9 paid holidays including an additional employee-selected day
* Paid time off for sick leave, family leave, community service, holidays and vacation
* To learn more about our comprehensive benefits package, visit https://www.pae-engineers.com/careers/benefits. This information is provided per the Equal Pay Act

**Our commitment to pay equity**

PAE is a JUST label certified company; we demonstrate JUST label requirements within pay equity. Pay scales should meet or exceed applicable legislated wage requirements and industry standards and compensate, on the same basis, all individuals performing the same or similar work and work of equal value. We are committed to the principle of pay equity – paying employees equitably for substantially similar work. To learn more about pay equity and our commitments to equitable business practices, you may view our JUST label certification here: Living Future: Just Label Certification.

To find out more visit our website.

**What We’re Made Of**

Founded in 1967, PAE is a leading sustainable engineering and consulting firm on a mission to deliver clean air, energy, and water for all. We specialize in mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineering, building performance analysis, technology design, and lighting design (LUMA). PAE designs some of the nation's highest-performing and most regenerative built environments across the U.S., from Living Buildings to all-electric buildings and beyond. Learn more at pae-engineers.com.

Our portfolio includes over 100 LEED Platinum projects as well as dozens of projects that have either achieved or are pursuing the Living Building Challenge, Passive House, Architecture 2030, Carbon Neutral, Net Zero Energy, and Net Zero Water.

**Fine Print**

Please note that resumes received from third party recruiters or agencies will not be accepted unless requested directly by PAE Talent Acquisition and with a prior signed fee agreement. If candidates without a previously signed recruiter fee agreement are submitted, PAE reserves the right to engage with and hire those candidate(s) without any obligation financial or otherwise to the recruiter or agency.

In order to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals, employment decisions at PAE will be based on merit, qualifications and abilities. PAE does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, gender (sex), national origin, age, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical characteristics historically associated with race, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

PAE will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship. This policy governs all aspects of employment including: selection, job assignment, compensation, discipline, termination and access to benefits and training.

**Project Coordinator (Retail Construction, Entry-Level)**

**Location:** Buena Park, CA (On-Site)

**Compensation:** $22.00 - 26.00 per hour (DOE)

**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Non-exempt

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM (1-hour unpaid lunch)

StyleKorean Inc., operated by SILICON2 Co., Ltd., is a leading global distributor of Korean beauty products, offering a wide range of skincare, makeup, and beauty brands to international markets.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Project Coordinator (Retail Construction, Entry-Level) to support retail store construction and maintenance projects.

This position is ideal for someone who is highly organized, communicative, and interested in retail construction project coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Project Coordination: Track and update project schedules, timelines, and overall progress of retail construction projects
* Cross-Functional Communication: Communicate and follow up with General Contractors, Architects, Landlords, and internal HQ teams
* Construction Support: Assist with retail store build-outs and fixture (FF&E) installation coordination
* Maintenance Tracking: Monitor maintenance requests and follow up through completion
* Documentation: Organize and maintain project-related documents, contracts, and files
* TI Allowance Support: Assist with preparation of Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance reimbursement documentation
* Issue Management: Identify project issues and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely resolution
* Performing other duties as required

**Qualifications**  

* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple project timelines
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)
* Ability to follow through and manage tasks independently

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience in retail construction or Tenant Improvement (TI) projects
* Basic understanding of construction drawings, plans, or documentation
* Experience coordinating with contractors or vendors

* Proficiency in AutoCAD or SketchUp is a plus

* Bilingual in Korean and English is preferred, as this role involves communication with our Korean-speaking headquarters and vendors.

**Benefits & Perks**

* 100% company-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (PPO)
* 401(k) retirement plan with company matching
* Paid Time Off (PTO) + Paid Holidays
* Year-end discretionary bonus program
* Daily catered lunch provided
* Employee discounts on products

***Equal Employment Opportunity***

*StyleKorean Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.*

***Legal Authorization & Background Check***

*Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Employment sponsorship is not available for this position. Any employment offer is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.*

***Accessibility***

*StyleKorean Inc. will provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process, as required under applicable law.*

We sincerely appreciate all applications; however, only candidates selected for further consideration will be contacted.

jobs.title: Housing Counselor (Program Coordinator I)
jobs.description:
**Exciting Career Opportunity!**
  
  
**Please note that applications will only be accepted Wednesday, November 25, 2026 through Thursday, December 10, 2026 at 11:59 pm.**  
  
The City of Pasadena is seeking a Housing Counselor to join the newly created Rent Stabilization Department. Housing Counselors play a crucial role in providing tenants, landlords, and other stakeholders information about their rights and responsibilities as they relate to the Pasadena Fair and Equitable Housing Charter Article XVIII and other relevant laws.
  
  
In this role, Housing Counselors will:

* Empower tenants, landlords, and others to understand their rights and responsibilities under Pasadena's rent stabilization law (Charter Article XVIII) and other relevant laws.
* Provide clear and neutral information on topics like rent increases and eviction protections.
* Help tenants make informed decisions by presenting options without taking sides or giving legal advice.
* Connect tenants with legal resources when needed.
* Simplify Rent Stabilization processes for everyone by assisting with requests for mediations, petitions, and accessing other city services.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**
  
The *ideal candidate* will have knowledge of housing policies and/or landlord-tenant law. A key function of this position is to serve as a neutral party, so excellent communication skills, diplomacy, and relationship building are key to success. Strong organizational skills, action and results focus, and critical thinking skills are also required.
  
  
This is an exciting career opportunity to be part of a team of professionals that will help establish and flourish this new city department providing vital services to our Pasadena community. Come be a part of our team!

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

The major responsibilities of this position are listed.

* Provides housing counseling and technical support to the public regarding the Pasadena Fair and Equitable Housing Charter Article XVIII and other relevant laws which includes responding to telephone inquiries, emails, providing services in appointments (in-person & virtual) and engaging in other public information activities as directed.
* Works closely with and provides technical assistance, directly or through subordinate staff, to the Rent Stabilization Department, and community and neighborhood-based committees and programs.
* Compiles and analyzes data; prepares written and oral reports for the Rent Stabilization Department, Hearing Officers, and other senior staff on a variety of development policies and programs.
* Works with the program supervisor, other City departments and public agencies, boards and commissions, and the private sector in developing a comprehensive and integrated approach to the administration of the local rent stabilization laws and regulations.
* Works with various community groups and membership organizations to encourage an interest in program goals and projects.
* Organizes special community education programs, workshops, conferences, meetings, and speaker's bureaus; advises departmental personnel on the use of educational materials and techniques and the use of community resources.
* Represents the Rent Stabilization Department at meetings, events, and in contacts with other agencies, commissions, business and community groups, and members of the public.
* Provides technical assistance to others on the Charter and related regulations; may supervise support staff on a project or regular basis.
* Utilizes customer service software to create/update case management notes and generate reports tracking key metrics including extensive use of excel.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**Qualification Guidelines**
----------------------------

**COMPETENCIES**
  
The following list represents the core competencies needed for success in this position.

* **Action & Results Focus** - Initiating tasks and focusing on accomplishment.
* **Attention to Detail** - Focusing on the details of work content, work steps, and final work products.
* **Professional Integrity & Ethics** - Displaying honesty, adherence to principles, and personal accountability.
* **Oral Communication** - Engaging effectively in dialogue.
* **Customer Focus** - Attending to the needs and expectations of customers.
* **Relationship Building** - Establishing rapport and maintaining mutually productive relationships.
* **Critical Thinking** - Analytically and logically evaluating information, propositions, and claims.
* **Legal & Regulatory Navigation** - Understanding, interpreting, and ensuring compliance with laws and regulations.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**
  
Any combination of education and/or experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary for acceptable job performance would qualify. Example combinations include: bachelor's degree in sociology, political science, public policy, public administration, psychology, social science, or a closely related field and two years of professional-level experience in developing and/or delivering housing or legal service programs. Individuals with rental housing advocacy and counseling experience will be deemed most qualified.
  
  
**SELECTION PROCESS**
  
The selection process may consist of a training and experience evaluation, interview panel, and/or department-level interviews.
  
  
**VACANCY INFORMATION**
  
The resulting eligibility list from this recruitment may be used to fill similar vacancies in the future.
  
  
Candidates selected for this position are subject to a one year probationary work period.

**Special Requirements**
------------------------

Must have or obtain a Class C California driver's license and a satisfactory driving record, as they may be required for some assignments.

CSUDH, Toro Auxiliary Partners
  
  
Full-Time | Non-Exempt | Benefited | Onsite |
  
  
About CSUDH Toro Auxiliary Partners
  
The California State University, Dominguez Hills (CSUDH) Toro Auxiliary Partners was established in 1968 to serve as a strategic partner of the university. The Auxiliary provides essential services, supports innovative programs, and enhances initiatives that are integral to the university’s educational mission.
  
  
About CSU Dominguez Hills
  
Founded in 1960, CSU Dominguez Hills is one of 23 campuses in the California State University system. The university is recognized for its rich diversity and serves as a vital educational hub for the South Bay region of Los Angeles County. Its mission is to foster academic excellence and community engagement in a dynamic, metropolitan environment.
  
  
Position Summary
  
Under the direct supervision of the Associate Director, the Program Coordinator I assists with the implementation and coordination of the federally funded TRIO Educational Talent Search (ETS) Program, serving low-income and potential first-generation college students within the Inglewood Unified School District. The Program Coordinator I carries out assigned program activities in accordance with established policies, procedures, and program requirements and receives guidance and direction from the Director in planning, implementing, and evaluating program services.
  
  
The Program Coordinator I provides academic and career advising to participants and assists with college access, academic support, career pathway exploration, financial aid assistance, recruitment, Individualized Service Plan (ISP) development, data collection and tracking, and program activities. Under the direction of the Director, the position supports participants in achieving academic and career goals, including secondary school persistence and graduation, completion of rigorous programs of study, postsecondary enrollment or entry into Registered Apprenticeships, and attainment of postsecondary degrees and credentials.
  
  
The Program Coordinator assists with program data collection, recordkeeping, reporting, and monitoring of participant progress to support program accountability and compliance with federal TRIO requirements. The position may also assist with the coordination and monitoring of academic tutors and/or student staff, as assigned, and perform other program-related duties under the direction of the Director.
  
  
**The position supports the grant's Absolute Priority:** Expanding Education Choice, with responsibility for Absolute Priority B (pre-apprenticeships and Registered Apprenticeships) and Absolute Priority C (programs or coursework leading to in-demand, industry-recognized postsecondary credentials).

* Inglewood High School: 300 Students
* City Honors High School: 300 Students
* Based on the annual carryover of approximately 400 returning participants, each Program Coordinator is typically expected to fully recruit approximately 20 new eligible participants each month during the academic-year recruitment period from September through mid-June.

Position Information
  
Employment at Toro Auxiliary Partners is on an at-will basis. It can be terminated by either an employee or Toro Auxiliary Partners at any time with or without cause or advanced notice. Permanent status can neither be obtained nor granted. This position is full-time, nonexempt, benefited, plus employer-sponsored health, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement, and sick/vacation pay.
  
  
**Hourly Rate:** $25.00 (3 available positions)
  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  
Recruitment & Outreach
  
  

* Coordinate recruitment and outreach efforts at Inglewood HS and City Honors HS to maintain the approved annual participant caseload.
* Conduct classroom presentations, parent/guardian workshops, informational sessions, and outreach activities communicating ETS eligibility, services, objectives, and college/career pathway opportunities.
* Review applications and supporting documentation; verify participant eligibility; support participant
* selection and enrollment in accordance with federal TRIO requirements. Submit documents to the Associate Director for final approval of participants.
* Under the direction of the Director, maintain collaborative relationships with school administrators, counselors, teachers, school CTE liaisons, community organizations, workforce partners, and referral partners.

Participant Case Management, Academic & Postsecondary Services
  
  

* Maintain an active caseload and develop, implement, and monitor Individualized Service Plans (ISPs) for assigned participants.
* Provide individualized and group academic, career, college, and financial aid advising.
* Monitor GPA, course completion, A-G/Rigorous Secondary School Program of Study progress, attendance, graduation requirements, and postsecondary preparation milestones.
* Help with college admissions, FAFSA, scholarships, and postsecondary enrollment.
* Coordinate report card reviews, persistence/dropout-prevention interventions, and summer melt prevention.
* Track progress toward the five project objectives: persistence; regular diploma graduation; rigorous secondary school program completion; postsecondary education or Registered Apprenticeship enrollment; and postsecondary degree/credential attainment.

jobs.title: RN Response Team Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**

As our Response Team Program Coordinator RN (RTPC) within the Clinical Response/Code Team, you will be a highly skilled and experienced individual responsible for providing immediate assessment, intervention, and stabilization to patients exhibiting signs of clinical deterioration or experiencing a medical emergency (e.g., Code Blue, Rapid Response).  
  
Every day you will serve as a critical resource for the hospital, working collaboratively with physicians, other nurses, and interdisciplinary team members to improve patient outcomes and prevent adverse events. You will utilize advanced clinical judgment, critical thinking skills, and expertise in resuscitation and advanced life support to provide optimal patient care in high-pressure situations, ensuring timely and effective responses to urgent medical needs.  
  
To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate exceptional clinical expertise in emergency and critical care, superior critical thinking ability, and the capacity to lead and collaborate effectively under pressure. Your commitment to rapid assessment, decisive intervention, and continuous improvement in patient outcomes will be fundamental in mitigating adverse events and maintaining the highest standards of patient safety.

Clinical Expertise and Leadership:  

* + Serves as a clinical resource and mentor for other nurses, providing guidance and support in the management of critically ill patients.  
  + Maintains current knowledge of best practices in critical care, resuscitation, and emergency medicine.  
  + Participates in the development and implementation of policies and procedures related to rapid response, code blue, and all other emergency code responses across the hospital campus  
  + Identifies opportunities to improve patient safety and quality of care.  
  + Collaborates with department leaders, staff, and quality/ risk to complete timeline reviews and data abstraction  
  + Participates in hospital committees and initiatives related to critical care and emergency preparedness.  
  + Develops Education/ training based on trends/ opportunities for clinical knowledge share. Collaborates with education / simulation lab team to deliver education.
Communication and Collaboration:  
* + Communicates effectively with physicians, nurses, and other members of the healthcare team.  
  + Provides clear and concise reports to the attending physician and other relevant providers.  
  + Maintains a professional and respectful demeanor in all interactions.  
  + Collaborates with other departments (e.g., respiratory therapy, pharmacy) to ensure optimal patient care.
* Responds to all clinical emergency calls in the hospital and surrounding designated areas.
Code Blue Response:  
* + Responds immediately to Code Blue activations throughout the hospital.  
  + Assumes a leadership role in the resuscitation effort, coordinating team members and ensuring adherence to established protocols.  
  + Will lead and or participate in post-code debriefings to identify areas for improvement in the resuscitation process.  
  + Performs advanced life support measures, including chest compressions, ventilation, defibrillation, and medication administration, according to ACLS guidelines.  
  + Monitors patient response to interventions and adjusts treatment as needed.  
  + Documents all events during the Code Blue, including interventions, medications administered, and patient outcomes.
Code OB / Code Crimson / Code White:  
* + Assumes a leadership role in the overseeing the coordination of team members, ensuring adherence to established protocols and assisting with the escalation process as needed.  
  + Will lead and or participate in post-code debriefings to identify areas for improvement in the resuscitation process.
Rapid Response:  
* + Conducts rapid and thorough assessments of patients exhibiting signs of clinical deterioration (e.g., changes in vital signs, altered mental status, respiratory distress).  
  + Initiates appropriate interventions based on assessment findings, including oxygen therapy, medication administration, fluid resuscitation, and airway management.  
  + Collaborates with the primary care team to develop and implement a plan of care to stabilize the patient and prevent further deterioration.  
  + Provides education and support to bedside nurses on early recognition of clinical deterioration and appropriate interventions.  
  + Documents all assessments, interventions, and patient responses accurately and completely in the electronic health record.

**Job Requirements**

Required

* Bachelors Of Nursing, upon hire and
* Registered Nurse: CA, upon hire and
* Basic Life Support - CPR, upon hire and
* Advanced Cardiac Life Support, upon hire and
* Pediatric Advanced Life Support, upon hire and
* Critical RN Adult/Neonatal/Pediatric/Acute, within 6 - months and
* Certified EKG Tech, upon hire and
* Fire Safety, upon hire and

Preferred

* Masters Of Nursing, upon hire
* Neonatal Resuscitation Program, upon hire

Where You'll Work

Founded in 1887, Dignity Health - California Hospital Medical Center is a 318-bed, acute care, nonprofit hospital located in downtown Los Angeles, California. Serving over 100,000 patients annually, the hospital offers a full complement of services including a Level II Trauma Center, Level III NICU, heart care, women’s health, and a family birth center. In 2025, we opened our new patient tower, Grand Tower, featuring a dramatically expanded Emergency Department and Family Birth Center that will increase patient comfort and privacy.

Additionally, California Hospital Medical Center has been recognized as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality Leader by the Human Rights Campaign Foundation. jobs.description:
**Position Title:**

**SEWP - Program Coordinator**

**Position Overview**

Golden Star Technology (GST) is seeking a detail-oriented SEWP Program Coordinator to support the daily operations of our **NASA SEWP contract vehicle**. This role is responsible for reviewing customer RFQs and bids, obtaining vendor pricing, and developing accurate sales quotes, sales proposals, and contract submissions for federal government customers.

The ideal candidate has experience in federal contracting, government procurement, proposal development, and **inside or outside sales**. Success in this role requires the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, and deliver timely, compliant, and competitive responses in a fast-paced technology and public sector sales environment.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage day-to-day activities supporting GST's NASA SEWP contract vehicle.
* Review customer **RFQs**, **RFPs**, **RFIs** and bid requests to ensure accurate, complete, and timely responses.
* Obtain and evaluate pricing, product availability, and lead times from OEMs, distributors, and vendor partners.
* Build, price, and submit accurate quotations, proposals, and supporting documentation for federal government customers.
* Support the full quote-to-order process, including opportunity qualification, quote development, proposal submission, and order handoff.
* Ensure compliance with NASA SEWP contract requirements, federal procurement guidelines, and company policies.
* Partner with Federal Account Executives to support sales opportunities, customer requests, and business growth initiatives.
* Collaborate with procurement, engineering, contracts, finance, and sales teams to develop competitive and compliant solutions.
* Track quote activity, sales pipeline metrics, contract utilization, and proposal status.
* Maintain contract records, customer documentation, and reporting within CRM, ERP, CPQ, and quote management systems.

**Required Qualifications**

* **3+ years of proven inside or outside sales experience**, including direct customer engagement, **quote generation, proposal development, and sales cycle management.**
* Experience supporting federal government contracts, procurement, or acquisition programs.
* Experience preparing and managing quotes, proposals, bids, and RFQ responses.
* Strong understanding of government purchasing processes and contract compliance requirements.
* Experience working with OEMs, distributors, and vendor partners.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written, verbal, and customer service communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across sales, procurement, contracts, finance, and vendor teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building, pricing, and submitting complex quotes and proposals for federal government customers.
* Experience supporting NASA Solutions for Enterprise-Wide Procurement **(SEWP)**, General Services Administration **(GSA)** Schedules, Government-Wide Acquisition Contracts **(GWACs),** Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity **(IDIQ)** contracts, or similar federal contract vehicles.

* Knowledge of the **Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)** and government procurement practices.
* Experience working with OEMs, distributors, and vendor pricing programs.
* Experience with **NetSuite, Salesforce,** or other **ERP, CRM, or quote management platforms**.
* Experience in the IT, technology, government contracting, or VAR industry.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**About GST**

**Golden Star Technology Inc. (GST)**, headquartered in Cerritos, California, has been recognized by the *Los Angeles Business Journal* as one of **LA's Best Places to Work** for seven consecutive years. As a leading provider of IT and audiovisual (AV) solutions and services, GST serves small and mid-sized businesses, enterprises, government agencies, and educational institutions nationwide.

Since its founding in 1985, GST has built a strong reputation for innovation, reliability, and customer commitment. The company's continued growth is driven by its ability to deliver a comprehensive portfolio of industry-leading technology solutions, customized configurations, and exceptional customer service. **Description**

Under direction of the Principal Investigator (PI) and the CTU/CRS Manager, the employee is to perform research activities directly related to HIV clinical trials in the Center for Clinical AIDS Research and Education (CARE Center) including but not limited to the AIDS Clinical Trials Group (ACTG), HIV Prevention Trials Network (HPTN), HIV Vaccine Trials Network (HVTN), and COVID19 Prevention Trials Network (CoVPN). The incumbent will be directly responsible for assisting with fast-paced implementation of HIV trials; assigned start up and closure of clinical research studies, participant registration, randomization, compliance, participant recruitment, enrollment, data management and education as related to each protocol. Document signs, symptoms and other changes for reporting to PIs as appropriate with research participants; assist in report preparation for IRB, IBC, CTSI/CTRC, radiology and other ancillary departments and/or committees. Participate in quality assurance activities for studies across the research unit. Interact with study monitors regarding protocol management and resolution of study queries. Work with outreach team in expanding recruitment efforts for HIV trials. Assist in drafting general standard operating procedures for CARE Research, as well as study-specific standard operating procedures, source documents, and forms. Assist with all aspects of preparation for and conduct of regulatory audits. Other tasks as assigned.

Pay range: $38.19 - $61.45 an hour

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Ability to effectively communicate to and interact with patients in a compassionate and kind manner.

jobs.title: Associate Program Specialist - Catering Support
jobs.description:
**About the Team**  
  
This role team sits within Uber’s Customer Advocacy & Solutions CX organization which owns the end-to-end support experience for our users. We design and improve support that anticipates customer needs, resolves issues, and builds trust. Our mission is to move beyond resolving tickets to owning customer outcomes. Catering is one of the most operationally complex experiences we support. Orders are large, scheduled, and high-value, often tied to events with fixed start times, such as team offsites, client meetings, or large social gatherings. Each order connects customers, merchants, and couriers, so a single issue can have a significant impact. We build clear support processes and tools that help our global agent network coordinate across these groups and deliver reliable, timely & proactive support.  
  
**About the Role**  
  
We’re looking for an Associate Program Specialist to grow & improve the end-to-end support experience as Catering grows. You’ll partner with other Customer Advocacy & Solutions (CAS) and business teams to address root causes and prevent recurring issues. **About Pallet**

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We've raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, and control.

As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we're positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

**$100,000 - $140,000**  
Full-time / Onsite (5 days/week) / ~25% Travel

**About The Role**

As a Field & Event Marketing Manager at Pallet, you will be on the front lines of how we show up in the market, from major industry conferences to intimate executive dinners, customer roundtables, and targeted field campaigns.

This role owns the planning and execution of high-impact programs that create demand, deepen customer relationships, build brand awareness, and directly influence pipeline. That includes choosing the right events, coordinating logistics, partnering with Sales on pre- and post-event outreach, creating memorable attendee experiences, and measuring what worked.

The ideal candidate is equal parts creative campaign thinker, operational project manager, and revenue partner. They thrive in fast-moving environments, bring structure to complexity, and get excited about turning ideas into programs that sales teams actually use and prospects remember.

**This role is for you if**

* Sees field marketing as a growth engine, not just an events function.

* Can move between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution, from building an event plan to digging through attendee lists, pipeline data, and conversion metrics.
* Takes ownership, figures things out proactively, and jumps in wherever needed.
* Cares about business outcomes and can connect field marketing work to pipeline, revenue, relationships, and broader company goals.
* Thinks outside the box and gets excited about unconventional, guerrilla, and sometimes absurd marketing ideas that break through the noise.

**This role is likely not for you if**

* Sees field marketing primarily as attending events, hosting dinners, and managing on-site logistics.
* Enjoys the experiential side of events but not the planning, targeting, data analysis, and follow-through behind them.
* Prefers to own one narrow piece of a program rather than taking responsibility from strategy through execution and measurement.
* Defaults to traditional marketing playbooks over experimenting with unconventional ways to reach people.
* Prefers structured guidance and established processes over independently navigating ambiguity.

**What You'll Do**

* Execute up to three field programs per week, managing end-to-end planning through post-program analysis, including events, dinners, activations, and other creative campaigns
* Develop creative out-of-home, ABM, and guerrilla marketing campaigns that reach target accounts in unexpected ways and break through the noise
* Manage and optimize event budgets across booths, sponsorships, travel, swag, and side events
* Partner with sales and marketing to align on goals, targeting, and execution, including building custom outreach for each campaign
* Identify high-impact events aligned with Pallet's ICP to maximize ROI and pipeline
* Analyze project performance to measure success and improve future programs
* Build and maintain scalable playbooks and templates for repeatable execution
* Share post-program insights and metrics to drive alignment and continuous improvement
* Stay calm under pressure and proactively solve problems during live events

**Who You Are**

* 2-5 years of experience in field marketing, sales, marketing, events, or a related role.
* Proven ability to independently manage end-to-end events within a 7-30 day turnaround, ideally having managed 20+ events per year.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with an eye for detail.
* Experience managing event budgets and vendor relationships.
* Ability to analyze program performance data and communicate actionable insights.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and troubleshoot issues in real time.
* Comfort proactively approaching, engaging, and building relationships with executives at all levels in event settings.

**Nice To Have**

* Exposure to product marketing, growth marketing, or go-to-market strategy
* Familiarity with B2B SaaS or enterprise software
* Experience working closely with sales teams
* Supply chain knowledge

**Life At Pallet**

* + Pallet is based in the heart of San Francisco & New York. We're a community built on transparency and a collective approach to problem-solving.
* Our team brings experience from companies like Ramp, Scale AI, Watershed, Rippling, and a range of FAANG backgrounds. Outside of work, we get together for monthly happy hours, weekly paid dinners, and coffee walks around the city.

**Our Process**

* Chat with Recruiter - 30 mins
* Chat with Hiring Manager - 30 mins
* Chat with Head of Marketing - 30 mins
* Proficiency Assessment - 24 hours to complete
* Final Interview (in SF office) - ~3 hours
* Brief Background Check and Reference Check

We move fast, and we'll keep you informed at every stage of the process.

**Ready to Build Exceptional Event Experiences?**

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Tolmo**
---------------

Tolmo is cybersecurity for the age of AI. Coding agents now ship software faster than any human team can review or secure it; 100+ pull requests per engineer per week is no longer an outlier, and attackers are using the same agents to find and exploit weaknesses in days, not months. The old playbook of quarterly pentests and endless alert queues breaks at this speed.

We're building a new security playbook. Tolmo runs a fleet of AI security agents that reason over a live graph of your entire production system (code, CI, cloud, and telemetry) and continuously attack a faithful copy of it like a real adversary. Every finding arrives validated, with its blast radius and a remediation plan that lands in your workflow, ready for a coding agent to fix. Hours to integrate, days to your first validated finding.

We've done this before: Tolmo's founders built Sqreen (acquired by Datadog) and led security products that thousands of organizations trusted. We're backed by Accel and Y Combinator and just getting started.

**The role**
------------

Security is a trust business, and trust gets built in the room. As our Field Marketing Manager, you create the gatherings, executive moments, and account-based campaigns that put Tolmo in front of the CISOs, CTOs, and security engineers at the companies we most want to work with, and you tie every one of them to pipeline.

You'll work hand in hand with the founders and sales, own each program from first idea to follow-up, and write the playbooks we'll grow on. We want a builder, not just a planner: you invent new formats, write your own invites, and set up your own automations.

**When you apply, tell us about a program you built from nothing and what it moved.**

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own our event presence:** the security, AI, and infrastructure conferences that matter (RSAC, Black Hat, BSides, and more), from booth and live demo to the side events people actually remember.
* **Run executive programs:** CISO and CTO dinners, roundtables, and workshops with the right people in the room, in San Francisco and our key markets.
* **Invent new formats:** hacker nights, live red-team demos, and capture-the-flag evenings. Pilot them, keep the ones that land, and turn them into a series.
* **Go after named accounts:** choose target accounts with sales, design multi-channel plays, and turn attention into first meetings.
* **Measure everything:** track sourced and influenced pipeline, cut what doesn't work, and double down on what does.
* **Automate the logistics:** let AI and tooling handle account research, invitations, follow-ups, and reporting, so your time goes to the people.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 5+ years in field marketing, events, or ABM, ideally at a security, developer tools, or infrastructure company.
* A track record of programs that created real pipeline, with numbers you can walk us through.
* At ease with deeply technical audiences and executives alike: you can brief a CISO and hang out with hackers.
* Organized and scrappy, and calm on-site when something breaks.
* Happy to travel regularly for conferences and customer events.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* An existing network in the security community.
* You've run joint events with cloud, security, or AI partners.
* You've built a community of security leaders, formal or informal.
* You've been the first field marketer at an early-stage startup.

**Compensation & benefits**
---------------------------

* **Competitive salary**, depending on level and experience.
* **Early-stage equity:** you're joining early; you'll own a real piece of what we build.
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and the equipment you need to do your best work.
* Based in San Francisco; we work in person.

*Tolmo is building a team with wide-ranging backgrounds, perspectives, and paths into security; we think it makes our product and judgment better. If you're excited about this role but don't match every point above, we'd still like to hear from you. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants of every background.*

jobs.title: Lead Conversion Specialist & Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Lead Conversion Specialist & Social Media Coordinator**

**Position Overview** Be Clinical is hiring a Lead Conversion Specialist to own the prospect-to-patient process and manage our social media presence. This is an onsite role: about 80% of your time will be spent converting inbound and outbound leads into booked consultations and paying patients, and the remaining 20% will focus on growing Be Clinical's social media channels. The ideal candidate is warm and persuasive on the phone, organized under a high lead volume, and has a strong eye for on-brand clinical/aesthetic content. You will be responsible for both creating the social media content that creates leads but also converting them into consultations.

**Position Split** 80% – Lead Conversion 20% – Social Media Management

**Key Responsibilities**

*Lead Conversion (80%)*

* Respond promptly to every inbound lead (web forms, phone, email, SMS, DMs) with industry-leading response times.
* Qualify prospective patients, understand their goals and concerns, and guide them toward the appropriate treatment or consultation.
* Book, confirm, and reduce no-shows for consultations and treatments through structured follow-up cadences (call, text, email).
* Re-engage aged, cold, and unconverted leads through targeted outreach and win-back campaigns.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of every lead, stage, and outcome in the CRM.
* Communicate pricing, packages, financing options, and pre/post-care information clearly and compliantly.
* Partner with clinical staff to ensure smooth handoffs from sales consult to treatment.
* Share lead quality feedback, common objections, and conversion insights with marketing.
* Hit or exceed monthly targets for consultations booked, show rate, and revenue converted.

*Social Media Management (20%)*

* Plan, create, schedule, and publish content across Instagram, TikTok, Instagram, and other relevant channels.
* Maintain a content calendar aligned with promotions, new treatments, seasonal campaigns, and provider spotlights.
* Capture and edit short-form video (Reels, TikToks) and photos in-clinic, including before/after content with proper patient consent.
* Write on-brand captions that reflect Be Clinical's voice and comply with advertising and medical/aesthetic guidelines.
* Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, tags, and reviews — routing qualified leads directly into the sales pipeline.
* Track engagement, follower growth, reach, and social-sourced leads; report monthly on performance.
* Stay current on platform trends, competitor activity, and aesthetic/clinical content best practices.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* 1–3+ years in sales, inside sales, patient coordination, or lead conversion with measurable results.
* Experience managing social media for a business or brand, including content creation and community management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; warm, professional, and confident phone presence.
* Strong organizational skills and comfort managing a high volume of leads and touchpoints.
* Comfort with CRM systems and social scheduling tools (e.g., Later, Meta Business Suite).
* Basic content creation skills using Canva, CapCut, or similar.
* Discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive patient information (HIPAA-aware).

*Preferred*

* Experience in medical aesthetics, med spa, dermatology, wellness, or a related clinical/consumer health environment.
* Familiarity with patient management platforms, booking software, and email marketing tools.
* Light photography or video editing skills.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Lead response time
* Lead-to-consultation and consultation-to-treatment conversion rates
* Consultation show rate
* Monthly revenue converted
* CRM data accuracy and pipeline hygiene
* Social engagement, follower growth, and social-sourced leads

**Schedule, Compensation & Benefits**

* Tuesday-Friday 9:30am-6:00pm & Saturday 9:00am-3:00pm
* Competitive base plus performance-based commission/bonus tied to conversion metrics.
* Paid time off and standard benefits.
* Ongoing training and professional development.
* Growth opportunities as Be Clinical expands.\

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $24.00 - $26.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Lead generation: 2 years (Required)
* Social media marketing: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Employment Duration:** 3 months (w/ potential for extension)

**Budgeted Pay Range:** $28.64–$44.78/hour

The UCSF School of Dentistry is seeking a detail-oriented and service-focused Procurement Analyst 2 to support inventory management, purchasing, and daily operations within our Predoctoral Clinics.

In this role, you will help ensure that dental students, faculty, and clinical teams have the supplies, materials, and equipment they need to provide excellent patient care and educational experiences.

This position combines inventory coordination, purchasing, vendor communication, and administrative support in a collaborative, fast-paced clinical education environment. The ideal candidate is organized, adaptable, comfortable working with inventory and purchasing systems, and enjoys supporting people and solving operational challenges.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Inventory Management:** Monitor, maintain, and replenish dental supplies, materials, and equipment across the Student Store, warehouse, and predoctoral clinics.
* **Purchasing and Procurement:** Prepare and process purchase orders, obtain vendor quotes, compare pricing, and coordinate purchases to ensure timely delivery of supplies.
* **Dental Lab Coordination:** Track and process dental laboratory cases, coordinate orders and shipments, and follow up with external laboratories as needed.
* **Student and Clinic Support:** Assist dental students and clinical staff with purchasing supplies and equipment, resolving inventory concerns, and addressing operational needs.
* **Warehouse Operations:** Receive, organize, track, and distribute inventory, maintain accurate stock records, and assist with physical inventory counts.
* **Financial and Administrative Support:** Maintain purchasing records, assist with cost comparisons, reconcile purchasing documentation, and prepare basic financial and inventory reports.
* **Systems and Data Management:** Enter and maintain accurate records using Microsoft Excel and departmental systems such as BearBuy, A-Star, and Epic.
* **Vendor and Stakeholder Coordination:** Communicate with vendors, clinical teams, and operational leaders to resolve purchasing issues and prevent supply disruptions.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Six months to one year of experience in purchasing, procurement, inventory management, supply chain operations, or a related field.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including basic data entry, spreadsheet management, and organization of information.
* Basic analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to review information, identify discrepancies, and compare purchasing options.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities and shifting priorities.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work professionally with students, staff, and vendors.
* Ability to learn and navigate new purchasing, inventory, and administrative systems.
* Ability to perform physical inventory and warehouse-related activities, including standing, walking, moving supplies, and handling equipment.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and experience.
* Experience working in a dental, healthcare, university, or clinical environment.
* Familiarity with purchasing or inventory management systems, including BearBuy, A-Star, Oracle, PeopleSoft, or similar applications.
* Experience with vendor coordination, purchase orders, inventory tracking, or financial reporting.
* Knowledge of UCSF purchasing policies and procedures.

jobs.description:
**About Sprig**
===============

Sprig is the enterprise survey platform, rebuilt around AI agents.

For two decades, companies have relied on Qualtrics, Medallia, and SurveyMonkey to understand their customers and markets. Those platforms were built for a slower era, with manual setup, fragmented workflows, and insights that arrive too late to shape decisions. The gap between how fast businesses move and how fast research can keep up has never been wider.

We're building something different. With Sprig, AI agents design studies, adapt surveys in real time, and turn responses into clear insight. Research, insights, and customer experience teams move from question to evidence in hours instead of weeks, without sacrificing rigor.

Our mission is to make deep customer understanding effortless and always on, so the world's leading companies can act on evidence instead of assumptions.

Leading companies like Microsoft, TikTok, DoorDash, and Coinbase trust Sprig to conduct research at scale. Backed by $85M in funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, and First Round Capital, we're rapidly expanding our enterprise presence.

We’re redefining the category, with AI at the core. If you're excited to solve hard problems and have the chance to shape how the world's largest companies understand their customers, we'd love to meet you.

**About the Role**
==================

We're hiring an **Enterprise Customer Success Manager** to own and grow relationships with some of the world's leading companies. You'll serve as a trusted strategic advisor, helping enterprise customers unlock the full value of Sprig, scale adoption across their organizations, and turn customer insights into meaningful business outcomes.

You'll own the **end-to-end customer lifecycle** for a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, from onboarding and adoption through expansion and renewal. Working closely with Sales, Product, and other cross-functional teams, you'll build executive relationships, identify growth opportunities, and drive strong customer retention and Net Revenue Retention (NRR).

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in shaping how leading enterprises adopt AI-powered research, while directly influencing Sprig's product and customer success strategy.

This role is based in our **San Francisco office 4 days per week**, with travel up to 25%.

* **Identify and execute expansion opportunities**, leveraging product usage, customer priorities, and stakeholder relationships to grow account revenue.

* **Champion the voice of the customer**, partnering with Sales and Product to influence the roadmap, improve the customer experience, and scale successful engagement strategies.

**Your Strengths**
------------------

* **5+ years of experience** in enterprise Customer Success, Account Management, or strategic consulting, ideally within B2B SaaS.

* **Strong commercial instincts**, with the ability to uncover growth opportunities, navigate renewals, and connect product value to business outcomes.
* **Executive presence and relationship-building skills**, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and navigating complex organizations.
* **Strategic and analytical mindset**, using customer data, product usage, and business insights to develop actionable success plans.
* **Exceptional communication and project management skills**, with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and manage competing priorities.
* **Proactive, resourceful, and adaptable**, thriving in a fast-paced environment where you can take ownership, solve problems, and help build scalable processes.

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* Competitive Salary
* Competitive Employee Equity
* 401K Program
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
* FSA/HSA Benefit
* $175/month Commuter Benefit
* Additional Wellbeing Benefits
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Professional Development Stipend
* Hybrid Office Policy
* Lunch and dinner daily
* Company Sponsored Social Events

At Sprig, we pride ourselves on being a people-first company, where your contributions truly matter and are valued. We were recently awarded by Fortune as top 50 best places to work in the US, and top 50 Places to Work in the Bay Area by Built In. Come join our mission of building products users love and have a real impact on Sprig’s future.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

We prioritize diversity within our team and value different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

The OTE range for this full-time position is $170,000 - $200,000 + Equity + Benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

BANANAS Inc. is seeking a **Client Services Enrollment Counselor.** The Client Services Enrollment Counselor is responsible for contacting and enrolling new families from the BANANAS Eligibility List (BEL) into our California Alternative Payment Programs (CAPP). This position also transfers eligible families into our CalWORKs Stage 2 program while providing excellent customer service throughout the enrollment process.

This position performs duties in support of BANANAS’ mission and program operations. The duties listed below represent the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform these essential functions.

Job duties, responsibilities, work locations, and schedules may change based on organizational needs.

**About BANANAS Inc.**

BANANAS is a nonprofit organization that supports families, children, and early care and education providers. Our programs help families connect with all types of child care options, from family child care, home-based settings, preschool centers, family, friend, neighbor caregivers, and nannies, so they can work or continue their education. Providers are supported with technical assistance and professional development. We are experts in the field of early care and education, and our wide variety of services supports families and child care providers in raising early learners. We offer workshops, playgroups, coaching, and support groups for parents and caregivers. Low-income families are supported with financial assistance so they can access quality child care. About the Company  
Our client is a leading global consumer technology and social media platform connecting hundreds of millions of users through content, lifestyle discovery and community. As it builds out its international creator ecosystem, it is hiring a Creator Growth & Community Manager to drive creator acquisition, engagement and retention in the US market. This is a newly created role with real ownership.

We are looking for a creative, entrepreneurial and data-driven professional who understands the creator economy and knows how to build thriving creator communities. You will develop scalable creator growth programmes, build relationships with creators across verticals, and help shape which content verticals the platform bets on in North America. You will work closely with Product, Growth, Content and Partnerships teams.

Creator Acquisition, Activation & Retention  

* Attract, onboard, activate and retain creators from TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Reddit and beyond

We're a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

**About the role**

We are looking for an Executive Assistant to support our Chief Executive Officer as part of Team CEO. As the right-hand partner to the CEO, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring each day is designed for impact.

We're seeking an experienced candidate who thrives in a high-intensity environment, embraces long work hours, and can handle a heavy workload with a very high work ethic. This role demands creativity, strategic thinking, and the ability to adapt to a fast-growing, rapidly changing environment that is mission-driven and community-oriented.

The ideal individual is both strategic and tactical, able to exercise sound judgment in various situations. Strong written and verbal communication, administrative, and project management skills are essential, as well as the ability to maintain a realistic balance across multiple priorities. You're always two steps ahead, comfortable diving in and rolling up your sleeves.

**What you'll do**

* Proactively manage the CEO's calendar, ensuring the most efficient uses of his time and that all meetings are aligned with the CEO and company goals
* Proactively collaborate with other Checkr EAs to improve executive operations across the leadership team
* Operate in a fast-paced and often low-information environment, leading without direct authority to move tasks and projects quickly to completion
* Prepare meeting agendas, take detailed notes in meetings, lead meetings on behalf of the CEO, and manage complex projects across multiple stakeholders
* Follow up on action items from meetings, shared via Slack and email, and arising from other workstreams, including managing the prioritization and hygiene of the CEO's dedicated Asana dashboard
* Serve as a trusted liaison between the CEO and both internal and external stakeholders
* Support CEO communications with trusted access to speak "as the CEO" via several means of communication, acting with utmost attention to confidentiality and discretion

**About the Team**  
  
This role team sits within Uber’s Customer Advocacy & Solutions CX organization which owns the end-to-end support experience for our users. We design and improve support that anticipates customer needs, resolves issues, and builds trust. Our mission is to move beyond resolving tickets to owning customer outcomes. Catering is one of the most operationally complex experiences we support. Orders are large, scheduled, and high-value, often tied to events with fixed start times, such as team offsites, client meetings, or large social gatherings. Each order connects customers, merchants, and couriers, so a single issue can have a significant impact. We build clear support processes and tools that help our global agent network coordinate across these groups and deliver reliable, timely & proactive support.  
  
**About the Role**  
  
We’re looking for an Associate Program Specialist to grow & improve the end-to-end support experience as Catering grows. You’ll review customer and agent feedback, analyze support performance, and turn insights into better processes, content, and tools. You’ll partner with other Customer Advocacy & Solutions (CAS) and business teams to address root causes and prevent recurring issues. This role combines analysis, process improvement, and cross-functional execution including using AI and automation to simplify recurring workflows.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  
  
**Understand customer needs and diagnose issues**  

* Review support tickets, customer feedback, and agent insights to identify recurring pain points across the support journey.
* Extract and analyze contact drivers and support trends to diagnose root causes and prioritize recommendations to reduce defects upstream.

  
**Improve support processes, tooling, and automation**  

* Design and improve support workflows, including time-sensitive catering journeys, with clear ownership, handoffs, and escalation paths.
* Use AI and automation where appropriate to simplify workflows, accelerate analysis, and reduce manual work while maintaining quality.
* Partner across teams to define tooling requirements, test solutions, and roll out improvements to the customer and agent experience.

* Keep SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge-base content clear and current as products and policies change, incorporating frontline feedback.
* Partner with Content, Tooling, Quality, and Training teams to prepare agents for launches and help them resolve more issues at first contact.

  
**Monitor performance and measure impact**  

* Report on key metrics, across experience, efficiency and support promise adherence to highlight trends, risks, and actions to improve performance.
* Work with global support sites and BPO partners to address performance gaps, measure results, and sustain improvements in quality and customer outcomes.

* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in program/project management, operations, or a highly agile, project-based environment.

**About Denn’s Room Psychiatry**

Denn’s Room Psychiatry is a growing psychiatric private practice serving adults in New York. We do psychiatric evaluations and medication management. We work alongside primary care providers, therapists and counseling practices, and community organizations such as homeless shelters and supportive housing programs. We want to be the psychiatric partner that healthcare professionals and community organizations across New York can count on.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a self-directed, relationship-driven marketer to introduce Denn’s Room Psychiatry to the people and organizations who need a reliable psychiatric partner. You’ll be the face of the practice in the community. You’ll build referral relationships with three groups:

1. **Primary care practices.** Physicians, NPs, and practice managers who need somewhere to send patients for psychiatric evaluation and medication management.

2. **Therapists and counseling practices.** Independent therapists, group practices, and counseling or mental health organizations whose clients need medication management.

3. **Shelters and residential programs.** Homeless shelters, supportive housing, and residential organizations that need psychiatric services for their clients.

**You own the strategy.** We won’t hand you a script or a route. You decide where to start, which neighborhoods and organizations to prioritize, and how to build the relationships. We want someone who treats this as their own territory.

**What You’ll Do**

**Field Day (about 8 hours per week)**

* Visit primary care offices, therapy and counseling practices, shelters, and supportive housing programs in person

* Introduce the practice, leave materials, and identify the right contact at each site (practice manager, referral coordinator, case manager, program director)

* Attend community, provider, and networking events when they’re useful

* Find organizations that could become direct service contracts, such as shelters and residential programs

**Admin and Follow-Up Block (about 4 hours per week)**

* **Documentation:** Log every visit, contact, and conversation in the practice’s outreach tracker (who you met, what they need, next step)

* **Follow-up calls and cold calls:** Call back the contacts you met in person, work new leads, and turn interest into referrals

* **Patient scheduling:** Schedule referred patients into the provider’s available appointment slots using the practice’s calendar, and confirm the details with the patient or the referring office

* **Weekly update:** Send a short summary of visits, follow-ups, new referral sources, and patients booked

**Ongoing**

* Keep referral partners happy with prompt responses and smooth handoffs

* Share field feedback with the practice owner: what partners need, common objections, and gaps in what we offer

* Represent the practice professionally and with compassion when talking with vulnerable populations

*As the practice grows, patient scheduling will move to a dedicated virtual assistant or practice manager, so you can focus fully on outreach.*

**Requirements**

* **Experience in marketing, outreach, sales, or business development** (healthcare or community-based preferred)

* Comfortable walking into offices unannounced, cold calling, and following up persistently

* Strong verbal and written communication

* Organized and self-directed. You can plan your own field day and keep accurate records without being micromanaged

* Comfortable with Google Workspace (Calendar, Sheets, Gmail) or similar tools

* Familiar with getting around NYC by public transit

* Discretion with confidential information. You’ll handle patient scheduling details and must complete HIPAA training before starting

* Authorized to work in the United States

**Preferred**

* **Background in case management, social work, community health work, or healthcare administration.** This helps you speak credibly with clinicians, case managers, and shelter staff

* Familiarity with the NYC shelter system, supportive housing, FQHCs, or community mental health organizations

* Basic understanding of insurance (commercial, Medicaid managed care, Medicare)

* Bilingual (Spanish or another language widely spoken in NYC)

* Existing relationships with NYC primary care, behavioral health, or social service organizations

**Compensation and Support**

* **Pay:** $24 to $28 per hour, based on experience

* **Additional incentives:** Performance-based incentives are available on top of the hourly rate

* **Transit:** The practice provides an OMNY card (or transit reimbursement) for work travel

* Flexible scheduling within the weekly hours

* Room to grow into a larger outreach or practice-growth role, including expansion into New Jersey

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and a few sentences about a relationship or referral source you built from scratch, and how you did it.

*Denn’s Room Psychiatry is an equal opportunity employer.*

Pay: $24.00 - $28.00 per hour

Expected hours: 12.0 per week

Work Location: On the road

jobs.description:
**About Kirkland & Ellis**

At Kirkland & Ellis, we don’t just meet the standard for legal excellence — we set it. Our culture is built on teamwork, ingenuity and an unwavering commitment to continuous growth. We tackle the most sophisticated legal challenges with bold ideas and innovative solutions, powered by the exceptional experience and ambition of our 7,000+ people, including 4,000+ attorneys, across 24 offices worldwide. Our dedicated professionals share our lawyers’ commitment to excellence and show up each day to do meaningful work that helps drive global business, investment and innovation forward.

**What You’ll Do**

Are you a detail-oriented purchasing professional who enjoys keeping complex processes moving, solving issues, and partnering with teams and suppliers to get things done?

As a Purchasing Coordinator, you’ll support the firm’s end-to-end purchasing and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) function, helping ensure purchasing transactions are accurate, timely, and compliant with firm policies. From reviewing requisitions and managing purchase orders to resolving invoice issues and maintaining supplier records, you’ll serve as a key resource for internal stakeholders and external suppliers. You’ll also partner closely with Procurement Sourcing and Finance teams to maintain accurate purchasing data, address process issues, and identify opportunities to improve the P2P experience.  
  

* Purchasing & Purchase Order Administration: Review and approve purchase requisitions, purchase order (PO) changes, and PO invoices, ensuring requests align with supporting supplier documentation, payment terms, fee schedules, timelines, descriptions, amounts, and required approvals.
* P2P Monitoring & Compliance: Monitor automated reports and end-to-end P2P workflows to identify delays, errors, trends, or noncompliance, researching issues, enforcing purchasing policies, and coordinating escalations and resolution as needed.
* Supplier & Order Management: Confirm suppliers are accurately established and active within the appropriate systems, ensure approved POs and PO change requests are successfully transmitted, and work directly with suppliers to fulfill orders and resolve purchasing or invoicing issues.
* Invoice & Payment Support: Collaborate with Finance teams and suppliers to resolve invoice matching discrepancies and help ensure supplier invoices are processed accurately and efficiently for payment.
* Supplier Onboarding & Records: Partner with internal business users, suppliers, Purchasing team members, and the Sourcing team to support new supplier onboarding and maintain accurate, up-to-date supplier and contract information within the P2P system.
* Customer Service & Coordination: Manage the shared Purchasing inbox, including daily triage, responses, internal coordination, and supplier communications, while providing responsive support to stakeholders throughout the purchasing process.
* Card-Based Purchasing: Process Purchasing Card (P-Card) and/or Virtual Card (V-Card) order requests in partnership with Procurement’s Vendor Management team.
* Team & Process Support: Provide coverage for Purchasing Coordinators in other offices, identify and recommend opportunities to improve P2P processes, and support additional Purchasing team needs as assigned.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in accounting or business, or equivalent experience along with a Purchasing Certification is required; 3+ years of purchasing or procurement experience required.
* Purchasing Experience: Three or more years of purchasing or procurement experience, with the ability to effectively support purchasing processes, stakeholders, and suppliers.
* Relationship & Customer Service Skills: Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers, supported by strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and a service-oriented approach.
* Organization & Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines, prioritize competing responsibilities, and maintain accuracy in a dynamic environment, with availability to work overtime periodically as business needs require.
* Professional Judgment & Confidentiality: Ability to communicate professionally with firm staff and suppliers while appropriately safeguarding confidential client and firm information.
* Technology Skills: Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, web browsers, and P2P software solutions, along with a willingness to learn and grow as processes and technologies evolve.

If you’re excited to keep purchasing operations running smoothly, build strong partnerships, and make an impact across the Procure-to-Pay process, we’d love to hear from you for this Purchasing Coordinator opportunity!

We also offer personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary:** Medical Diagnostic Laboratories (MDL), a member of Genesis Global Group, is a CLIA certified clinical laboratory with multiple state licensing, specializing in state of the art, automated DNA based molecular analysis of a variety of chronic and infectious illnesses.
  
  
MDL specializes and performs Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) with a larger menu of testing available in the field of infectious disease. Our main theme of research is in the field of Gynecology, Infectious Diseases, Infectious Arthritis, Tick-borne Diseases, Mycology, and Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS).
  
  
MDL is looking to expand its sales force throughout the U.S. We are seeking a high-energy, self-motivated individual to join our sales team. As an Entry Level Account Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining a large client base of existing customers for MDL and serve as a liaison between management and customers to resolve any customer issues.
  
  
**Essential Functions:**  

* Grow client base revenues by presenting new test information, up selling and seeking out new sources of revenue from existing clients
* Establish positive long-term client relations
* Educate and train clients, research problems and coordinate solutions between the laboratory and client
* Work closely with Senior Sales Executive and Regional Manager to identify client concerns and assist in the development and implementation of client retention strategies
* Monitor, evaluate, and report level of client satisfaction and recommend appropriate corrective action as required
* Maintain knowledge of competitors and their presence in assigned territory

* Well-developed multi-tasking, organizational skills, and detail orientation are key to success
* Energy, motivation, enthusiasm, and integrity
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Must demonstrate sound judgment and decision-making ability
* Computer proficiency in MS Office, Excel, e-mail and internet functions
* Knowledge of laboratory testing and competing products.
* Must be able to travel within the coverage area and occasionally nationwide

**Physical Demands:** Physical, Mental and Workplace Environment Conditions
  

* Use hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, or controls
* Ability to sit, stand and walk
* Ability to drive motor vehicle

**Workplace Conditions:** Workplace Environment Conditions
  

* Requires frequent traveling by motor vehicle
* May be exposed to various workplace environments when meeting with customers

**Education and Certifications:**  

* Medical Assistant certification or Associate Degree, BA/BS preferred.

Visit us at https://www.mdlab.com/
  
  
Medical Diagnostic Laboratories is a member of Genesis Global Group, an equal opportunity employer.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

### **The Opportunity**

As an SMB Account Manager at Braze, you aren't just managing a portfolio—you are the commercial strategist for the world's fastest-growing brands. You will act as a consultant and business analyst, helping SMBs leverage our industry-leading engagement platform to create "wow" moments for their customers. This is a high-visibility role where you will master the intricacies of multi-channel automation, APIs, and real-time analytics while driving the revenue that fuels our mission.

* **Drive Growth:** Own the full commercial lifecycle for a portfolio of SMB customers, consistently hitting Net Retention and Upsell targets by identifying untapped value.

* **Cross-Functional Catalyst:** Partner with Customer Success, Partnership, Product, and Legal teams to ensure a frictionless experience from onboarding to expansion.
* **Product Voice:** Distill complex customer feedback into actionable insights for our Product team, directly influencing the Braze roadmap.
* **Workflow Innovation:** Use AI and modern sales tools to automate the "busy work," allowing you to spend more time on high-value strategic conversations.

* Prior experience with Salesforce or similar CRM ecosystems.

* A passion for experimenting with AI to maximize individual output.
