jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**About Asphalt Green**

Asphalt Green is a nonprofit organization that transforms lives and builds community through sports, fitness, and play for all.

Each year, Asphalt Green serves thousands of New Yorkers through sports, aquatics, fitness, camps, and community programs that promote health, personal growth, and lifelong participation in physical activity. Across three campuses and numerous community partnerships, Asphalt Green is committed to providing high-quality programs that are inclusive, accessible, and rooted in excellence.

Asphalt Green believes that access to movement, sport, and wellness can change lives. Our work helps young people develop confidence, resilience, leadership skills, and healthy habits that extend far beyond the playing field.

**About the Role**

The Social Media Manager leads Asphalt Green’s social media strategy and day-to-day execution across major platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging channels.

This role is responsible for turning Asphalt Green’s programs, people, events, community impact, membership offerings, fitness experiences, and fundraising priorities into engaging social-first content that grows audiences and strengthens the organization’s digital presence.

The Social Media Manager manages content planning, creation, publishing, community engagement, performance reporting, and social media standards across the organization. The role also works closely with program and department teams to help ensure social media activity across Asphalt Green reflects a consistent brand voice, visual identity, and organizational strategy.

This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong creative instincts, sound judgment, organization, and the ability to balance storytelling with measurable performance.

**Why This Role Matters**

Social media is one of Asphalt Green’s most visible connections to members, families, athletes, donors, community partners, prospective participants, and the broader New York City community.

The Social Media Manager helps ensure that Asphalt Green shows up online in a way that is engaging, recognizable, timely, and aligned with the organization’s mission.

By combining strategy, storytelling, content production, audience engagement, and data, this role helps strengthen awareness, promote programs, support membership and fundraising priorities, and extend the reach of Asphalt Green’s work.

* Create engaging social-first content that highlights Asphalt Green’s programs, people, community, events, impact, and culture.

* Develop strategies that strengthen audience growth, engagement, retention, and community participation.
* Identify opportunities to amplify content from community partners, participants, influencers, athletes, and other external voices when aligned with Asphalt Green’s strategy.

Campaigns, Analytics & Paid Social Support

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

**Who Are We Looking For?**

Vestwell is transforming the way people save for the future through modern workplace savings and financial wellness solutions. We are building a high-performing sales organization where people are coached, challenged, and given a clear path to grow.  
  
The Business Development Representative (BDR) is a six-month development role designed to prepare high-performing sales professionals for a full-cycle Business Development position on our Financial Advisor channel. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
#### **About Us**

**ISMG** is a global media and intelligence firm covering cybersecurity, enterprise IT, and digital transformation. Through 10+ brands, 38 digital media properties, and more than 400 events each year, we reach over 2 million executives, decision-makers, and innovators. We help technology and cybersecurity companies connect with that audience through media campaigns, executive events, and demand generation programs.

#### **About the Opportunity**

As a **Sales Development Representative (SDR)**, you’ll help build ISMG’s new business pipeline by starting conversations with marketing leaders at technology and cybersecurity companies. You’ll learn who they’re trying to reach, what they want to achieve, and where an ISMG campaign or event could support their goals. When you identify a fit, you’ll arrange a discovery meeting with one of our Business Development Managers (BDMs) or Account Executives.

You’ll build your B2B sales skills through hands-on prospecting, daily coaching, and mentorship from experienced sellers. After successfully completing the development program, you may be considered for a BDM role with broader sales responsibilities and greater earning potential.

#### **What You’ll Do**

* **Research and prioritize accounts.** Identify prospective clients and the people who shape their marketing decisions. Use company news, buying signals, and prospecting tools to find a timely reason to reach out.
* **Start conversations.** Make cold calls, write personalized emails, and use social outreach to engage prospects. Tailor your message to the person’s role, audience, and marketing priorities.
* **Qualify opportunities and book discovery meetings.** Ask questions about the prospect’s goals and upcoming initiatives, assess where ISMG can help, and agree on a next step with the right member of our sales team.
* **Prepare the sales team for each meeting.** Share who will attend, what the prospect wants to accomplish, and why they agreed to meet so your colleague can pick up where you left off.
* **Manage performance against KPIs.** Work toward agreed activity and quality targets, tracking how often outreach leads to conversations and how many qualified meetings the sales team accepts and prospects attend. Review results with your manager and use coaching to improve your approach.
* **Maintain CRM records.** Keep outreach, qualification notes, meeting outcomes, and next steps current.

#### **What You Bring**

* An interest in building a B2B sales career and learning how technology companies reach cybersecurity and IT decision-makers.
* Clear writing and the willingness to pick up the phone and start a conversation with someone new.
* Curiosity and strong listening skills. You ask follow-up questions and use what you learn to shape the conversation.
* Persistence when prospects don’t respond, along with the organization to manage multiple accounts and follow through on commitments.
* A willingness to practice, act on feedback, and learn CRM and prospecting tools.

Previous sales, internship, or customer-facing experience is helpful. We also welcome applicants pursuing their first sales role. Familiarity with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or similar tools is a plus.

#### **What We Offer**

* A base salary, uncapped commission on initial sales from opportunities you generate, and the opportunity to earn quarterly bonuses for meeting qualified meeting targets.
* Structured onboarding, daily coaching from sales leadership, and mentorship from experienced sales representatives.
* Hands-on experience selling media, events, and demand generation programs to marketing decision-makers.

If you’re ready to build a career in B2B sales, we’d like to hear from you. **Apply today.**

About 70% of the work is focused on several ongoing hospitality and residential development projects in Florida, and about 30% is executive and personal support for the principal.

The role suits a sharp, early-career candidate who wants to build project management skills, is eager to be trained, is comfortable owning the details of someone’s day, and wants a front-row seat to how a real estate family invests in, develops, and manages property.

jobs.description:
**About the Agency:**

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.

As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.

**Your Team:**   
The Office of Development (OOD) leads the agency’s effort to create and preserve housing in collaboration with other HPD offices as well as other city, state and federal agencies.

The Office of Development is composed of eight divisions that administer a range of programs:

* New Construction Finance
* Special Needs Housing
* Building and Land Development Services (BLDS)
* Homeownership Opportunities and Preservation
* Preservation Finance
* Portfolio Management and Conversions
* Housing Incentives
* Compliance and Enforcement

The Division of Preservation Finance administers multiple financing programs to improve financial and physical conditions and preserve or create affordability within privately-owned multi-family and single-family buildings. The division oversees programs utilizing low-cost loans and property tax benefits among other public incentives.

**Your Impact:**  
The Division of Preservation Finance seeks an Assistant Administrative Project Manager for the Multifamily Cooperative Preservation Team. The unit develops plans, strategies, and tools for effective affordable housing preservation initiatives, as well as analyzes, negotiates, and executes on financial transactions to preserve the physical and operational integrity of existing affordable housing developments under the Multifamily Housing Rehabilitation Porgram (HRP). The unit provides rehabilitation loans to multifamily affordable housing developments that cannot leverage private financing and only require financing for the replacement of major building systems to improve living conditions and preserve safe affordable housing for low- and moderate-income households in New York City.

**Your Role:**

Under the supervision of the Director and Deputy Directors, as Administrative Assistant Project Manager, you will be primarily responsible for helping to coordinate the administrative functions of the unit. This role will be instrumental in helping to move projects toward closing and work with Director and Deputy Directors to prioritize projects and timeline for assignments.

**Your Responsibilities:**

As Administrative Assistant Project Manager, you will perform duties including, but not limited to the following:

· Assist Director(s) with program administration tasks including but not limited to creating, maintaining, and updating pipeline and other trackers for internal and external meetings, organizing and archiving electronic and hard copy project files, and updating due diligence checklists;

· Assisting Director(s) identify hurdles to timely completion of transactions;

· Provide coverage for Executive Director(s) phone lines and assist with managing the Director(s) calendars to schedule meetings and calls;

· Attend meetings, develop agendas and maintain minutes for various projects and internal and external meetings;

· Liaise with internal and external parties to gather information;

· Assist the team with tenant mailings and notices;

· Assist Project Managers and Senior Project Managers complete due diligence on their projects;

· Project manage 1-2 capitally funded projects through loan closing, including underwriting and completing due diligence requirements, as needed;

The ideal candidate will have experience in a collaborative environment, possess strong organization and communication skills, be detail-oriented, and be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

· Interest in community development, urban planning, affordable housing or real estate finance.

· Advanced computer skills including competency in full Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel.

· Capacity to simultaneously work on multiple tasks and set priorities for a challenging workload.

· Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Excellent writing and editing skills.

· 1-2 years of applicable experience working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment preferred.

**How to Apply:**

Please email resume and cover letter to: JobsPF@hpd.nyc.gov

**Salary range for this position is: approximately $70,000 annual salary (based on a 35 hour work week with a required unpaid lunch)**

**NOTE: Please note that this is a temp position that is anticipated to conclude approximately one (1) year from hire date or later. Please note that due to this being a Temporary Employment Position we are unable to sponsor candidates that require visa support.**

**Work Location:** **100 Gold Street, New York, NY**

Job Type: Temporary

Pay: $70,000.00 per year

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS is seeking a sales professional to manage a global customer relationship with one of our large global Automotive & Manufacturing customers. You will define and execute a CXO relationship strategy within the account, including engaging with a dedicated account team, AWS senior leaders for executive sponsorship, coordinating executive business reviews, and maintaining customer satisfaction.  
  
The Global Account Manager ("GAM") will partner with the customer to build strategic relationships, articulate a clear vision, and deliver business value. The successful GAM will develop and execute a broad strategy for earning customer trust and driving AWS solution and service adoption across the customer's Digital Technology, Operations, Line of Business (LoB), and Research & Development leadership. The GAM will work with all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Solution Architects, Customer Solutions Managers, Industry Specialists, Marketing, Partners, Support, Service Teams and Professional Services) to deliver customer outcomes. This is an Individual Contributor role, but necessitates an account leader mindset, and may included dotted line responsibility for downstream sales, technical and industry specialist resources. The GAM will also effectively leverage existing programs and mechanisms, innovate and scale new mechanisms, and develop formal case studies and other forms of references highlighting outcomes and solutions running on AWS.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Contributing to, and leading, within an AWS customer account team.  
  
Identifying and building trusted advisor relationships with key influencers and decision-makers, specifically CxOs at the customer, across Line of Business (LoB), Functional (R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain), and Digital & IT.  
  
Working closely with internal AWS teams (executives, solution architects, industry specialists, marketing, partners, enterprise support, service teams and professional services), as well as external SI and ISV partners, to support the best business solution(s) for customers.  
  
Defining a CXO relationship strategy within the customer, coordinating executive business reviews, and maintaining customer satisfaction levels.  
  
Displaying strong leadership presence and being able to command a room in a meeting. Should be seen as an authority in communicating via email, phone, and face to face, and comfortable writing executive briefing documents for, and communicating with, the most senior executives at the company.  
  
Operating with significant autonomy and discretion. A high degree of decision making is required in routine customer engagement, business judgment is critical.  
  
Managing a global sales pipeline via Salesforce and facilitating all stages of a sale.  
  
Participating and leading in the negotiation and closing of legal agreements, such as Enterprise Agreements (EAs), and contracts, such as Private Pricing Addendums (PPAs).

Working with marketing and communications to develop formal references, PR and case studies highlighting impactful customer activity and workloads running on AWS.  
  
About the team

**Community Manager**
=====================

**Connell Commons - Atlanta, GA**
=================================

**WHO WE ARE:**

Woda Cooper Companies, Inc**.** is a rapidly growing development, construction, and property management organization dedicated to the creation of quality affordable housing to benefit those who need it most. We are an employee-owned, passion-driven group that changes each community of which we are a part. We manage over 16,000 housing units in 19 states, proudly serving seniors, veterans, and other economically challenged groups. We seek ambitious, talented individuals who want to grow with a rapidly expanding company whose success is not only measured in dollars and cents, but in lives changed. With a development portfolio of $1.5 billion, Woda Cooper consistently ranks among the top affordable housing developers and owners in the country by Affordable Housing Finance.

**WHERE YOU'LL WORK:**

Connell Commons is a 144-unit affordable housing community located in Atlanta, Georgia, featuring six three-story residential buildings and a variety of resident amenities, including a clubhouse, community room, business center, playground, and outdoor gathering spaces. As the Community Manager, you'll oversee the day-to-day operations of the community, including resident relations, leasing, compliance, financial performance, and property operations. Working closely with residents, vendors, and your regional support team, you'll help maintain a safe, welcoming, and well-managed community while delivering exceptional customer service and supporting Woda Cooper's commitment to providing quality affordable housing.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Maintain positive interactions with residents and the public to enhance the community image and ensure superior resident retention.
* Lease apartments: take telephone inquiries; greet prospects; show apartments; take applications and deposits; verify income and credit information; follow up with all prospects; and ensure that leases and annual certifications are executed and renewed on a timely basis.
* Maintain the community's curb appeal, ensuring it always remains welcoming and attractive.
* Maintain confidentiality at all times related to prospect or resident information.
* Maintain secure handling of rents and all monies on site, daily deposits and record keeping.
* Oversee the process of collecting and posting all rents, tracking collections, pursuing delinquent accounts, issuing notices to residents, and attending proceedings in court as needed.
* Properly screen and score rental applicants, control delinquency and promptly process bad debt files to collections.
* Create and maintain a customer-centered service culture by demonstrating proactive hospitality with prospects, residents, family members and fellow community associates.
* Administer the community’s operating budget, including the control of monthly expenses using a budget control log, where applicable.
* Assemble complete and detailed credit and income information, along with necessary verification documents for prospective residents’ approval and re-certification, and forward to Compliance for approval.
* Maintain and ensure each resident file is in compliance with all SHFA commitments and any other governmental commitments; ensure each resident file complies with any and all lender and investor commitments.
* Track scheduled unit inspections via unit inspection log and ensure preventative maintenance is completed.
* Sign off vacant units as market-ready and provide feedback/work orders needed to maintain company standard.
* Inspect (walk) the property daily, and schedule capital improvements and repairs, including collecting bids based on common specs and forwarding them to the Regional Manager for approval.
* Ensure that all financial reporting, records and paperwork are performed correctly and in a timely manner.
* Review capital maintenance recommendations and forward them to the Regional Manager for approval.
* Maintain a constant awareness of neighborhood market conditions.

Orders are large, scheduled, and high-value, often tied to events with fixed start times, such as team offsites, client meetings, or large social gatherings. Each order connects customers, merchants, and couriers, so a single issue can have a significant impact. We build clear support processes and tools that help our global agent network coordinate across these groups and deliver reliable, timely & proactive support.  
  
**About the Role**  
  
We’re looking for an Associate Program Specialist to grow & improve the end-to-end support experience as Catering grows. You’ll review customer and agent feedback, analyze support performance, and turn insights into better processes, content, and tools. You’ll partner with other Customer Advocacy & Solutions (CAS) and business teams to address root causes and prevent recurring issues. This role combines analysis, process improvement, and cross-functional execution including using AI and automation to simplify recurring workflows.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  
  
**Understand customer needs and diagnose issues**  

* Review support tickets, customer feedback, and agent insights to identify recurring pain points across the support journey.
* Extract and analyze contact drivers and support trends to diagnose root causes and prioritize recommendations to reduce defects upstream.

  
**Improve support processes, tooling, and automation**  

* Design and improve support workflows, including time-sensitive catering journeys, with clear ownership, handoffs, and escalation paths.
* Use AI and automation where appropriate to simplify workflows, accelerate analysis, and reduce manual work while maintaining quality.
* Partner across teams to define tooling requirements, test solutions, and roll out improvements to the customer and agent experience.

  
**Enable frontline teams and prepare for launches**  

* Keep SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge-base content clear and current as products and policies change, incorporating frontline feedback.
* Partner with Content, Tooling, Quality, and Training teams to prepare agents for launches and help them resolve more issues at first contact.

  
**Monitor performance and measure impact**  

* Report on key metrics, across experience, efficiency and support promise adherence to highlight trends, risks, and actions to improve performance.
* Work with global support sites and BPO partners to address performance gaps, measure results, and sustain improvements in quality and customer outcomes.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in program/project management, operations, or a highly agile, project-based environment.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree or equivalent.
* 3+ years of experience in customer support, operations, program management, or CX in a fast-paced environment.
* Hands-on experience with contact center platforms, knowledge bases, workflow tools, or support automation.
* Experience designing and improving support processes, SOPs, or playbooks, and helping teams adopt them.
* Basic SQL proficiency and strong analytical skills to retrieve and analyze data, diagnose issues, and measure results.
* Ability to interpret Tableau or other BI dashboards and translate findings into recommendations.
* Experience using customer feedback and data to inform product or process improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into simple, agent-friendly guidance.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated experience aligning teams such as Product, Operations, BPO partners, Quality, and Training.
* Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation, change management, and follow-through.

The ideal candidate pairs a warm, hospitable personality with sharp business acumen and tech-savviness, moving comfortably between planning a polished professional conference and hosting a lively social mixer. * Create marketing collateral for property programming and events using property-specific branding.

jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Kirkland & Ellis**

At Kirkland & Ellis, we don’t just meet the standard for legal excellence — we set it. Our culture is built on teamwork, ingenuity and an unwavering commitment to continuous growth. We tackle the most sophisticated legal challenges with bold ideas and innovative solutions, powered by the exceptional experience and ambition of our 7,000+ people, including 4,000+ attorneys, across 24 offices worldwide. Our dedicated professionals share our lawyers’ commitment to excellence and show up each day to do meaningful work that helps drive global business, investment and innovation forward.

**What You’ll Do**

Are you a detail-oriented purchasing professional who enjoys keeping complex processes moving, solving issues, and partnering with teams and suppliers to get things done?

As a Purchasing Coordinator, you’ll support the firm’s end-to-end purchasing and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) function, helping ensure purchasing transactions are accurate, timely, and compliant with firm policies. From reviewing requisitions and managing purchase orders to resolving invoice issues and maintaining supplier records, you’ll serve as a key resource for internal stakeholders and external suppliers. You’ll also partner closely with Procurement Sourcing and Finance teams to maintain accurate purchasing data, address process issues, and identify opportunities to improve the P2P experience.  
  

* Purchasing & Purchase Order Administration: Review and approve purchase requisitions, purchase order (PO) changes, and PO invoices, ensuring requests align with supporting supplier documentation, payment terms, fee schedules, timelines, descriptions, amounts, and required approvals.
* P2P Monitoring & Compliance: Monitor automated reports and end-to-end P2P workflows to identify delays, errors, trends, or noncompliance, researching issues, enforcing purchasing policies, and coordinating escalations and resolution as needed.
* Supplier & Order Management: Confirm suppliers are accurately established and active within the appropriate systems, ensure approved POs and PO change requests are successfully transmitted, and work directly with suppliers to fulfill orders and resolve purchasing or invoicing issues.
* Invoice & Payment Support: Collaborate with Finance teams and suppliers to resolve invoice matching discrepancies and help ensure supplier invoices are processed accurately and efficiently for payment.
* Supplier Onboarding & Records: Partner with internal business users, suppliers, Purchasing team members, and the Sourcing team to support new supplier onboarding and maintain accurate, up-to-date supplier and contract information within the P2P system.
* Customer Service & Coordination: Manage the shared Purchasing inbox, including daily triage, responses, internal coordination, and supplier communications, while providing responsive support to stakeholders throughout the purchasing process.
* Card-Based Purchasing: Process Purchasing Card (P-Card) and/or Virtual Card (V-Card) order requests in partnership with Procurement’s Vendor Management team.
* Team & Process Support: Provide coverage for Purchasing Coordinators in other offices, identify and recommend opportunities to improve P2P processes, and support additional Purchasing team needs as assigned.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in accounting or business, or equivalent experience along with a Purchasing Certification is required; 3+ years of purchasing or procurement experience required.
* Purchasing Experience: Three or more years of purchasing or procurement experience, with the ability to effectively support purchasing processes, stakeholders, and suppliers.
* Relationship & Customer Service Skills: Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers, supported by strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and a service-oriented approach.
* Organization & Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines, prioritize competing responsibilities, and maintain accuracy in a dynamic environment, with availability to work overtime periodically as business needs require.
* Professional Judgment & Confidentiality: Ability to communicate professionally with firm staff and suppliers while appropriately safeguarding confidential client and firm information.
* Technology Skills: Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, web browsers, and P2P software solutions, along with a willingness to learn and grow as processes and technologies evolve.

If you’re excited to keep purchasing operations running smoothly, build strong partnerships, and make an impact across the Procure-to-Pay process, we’d love to hear from you for this Purchasing Coordinator opportunity!

**Compensation**

The base salary range below represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position in each of the below locations. This range may differ based on your geographic location and cost of living considerations. At Kirkland & Ellis, we consider compensation more than just a base salary. We offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits including comprehensive healthcare, paid time off, and retirement. We also offer personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

Compensation Range:

New York: $58,000 - $80,000

Chicago: $58,000 - $72,000

jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Director, Customer Success  
**Location and Working Pattern:** New York Metro Preferred (Manhattan ideal), Hybrid/Flexible, Remote employment for the ideal candidate

**Department:** Sales

**Salary Range:** $145k-$175k OTE including base salary and variable commission

(Final compensation will be commensurate with experience and location)

**Who We Are**

QA is a global leader in technology and digital skills development, helping organizations build critical capabilities across AI, cloud, cybersecurity, data, software development, DevOps, digital transformation, leadership, and professional skills through instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, and digital learning solutions.

**Role Overview**

The Customer Success Manager serves as the primary customer success partner for a portfolio of mid-market and scaled customers. The role is responsible for driving customer adoption, retention, value realization, and overall customer health throughout the customer lifecycle. Working in partnership with Account Managers, the Customer Success Manager develops and executes customer success strategies that help customers achieve measurable business outcomes while identifying growth opportunities that can be advanced through Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs). Success in this role requires a combination of customer success expertise, stakeholder management, program coordination, and scalable customer engagement capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Lifecycle Management**

* Own customer onboarding, adoption, engagement, and value realization activities across an assigned portfolio.
* Develop and maintain customer success plans aligned to customer goals and business outcomes.
* Proactively identify customer risks and drive mitigation plans to improve retention and customer outcomes.
* Serve as the primary advocate for customer needs and objectives throughout the customer lifecycle.

**Customer Success & Retention**

* Drive ongoing customer adoption and utilization across QA learning solutions.
* Maintain a clear understanding of customer objectives, use cases, stakeholders, and success measures.
* Support renewal planning activities in partnership with assigned Account Managers.

**Joint Account Strategy & Planning**

* Partner closely with Account Managers to develop and execute account success strategies.
* Contribute customer insights, stakeholder intelligence, adoption trends, and risk assessments to account planning activities.
* Identify Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) and collaborate with Account Managers to advance growth opportunities.
* Align customer success activities to broader account objectives and customer business priorities.

**Program Coordination & Execution**

* Coordinate instructor-led training engagements and blended learning programs.
* Manage customer communications, milestones, action plans, and stakeholder alignment activities.
* Monitor program progress, identify delivery risks, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure successful execution and customer outcomes.

**Executive Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across technology, learning and development, and business functions.
* Facilitate business reviews and outcome-focused customer discussions.
* Present recommendations, adoption insights, and success strategies to customer stakeholders.
* Navigate complex customer environments with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

**Scaled Customer Success & Adoption**

* Deliver one-to-many and one-to-few customer engagement activities, including webinars, office hours, enablement sessions, and adoption-focused campaigns.
* Use customer health indicators, engagement trends, lifecycle milestones, and success metrics to prioritize and execute digital customer success activities at scale.
* Gather customer feedback, identify recurring challenges, and implement scalable approaches that improve customer experience, adoption, and outcomes.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
* Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs)
* Customer Adoption and Engagement
* Verified Customer Outcomes
* Success Plan Completion
* Customer Advocacy, Reference Participation, and Business Review Completion

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Learning Services, Professional Services, or customer-facing consulting roles.
* Experience supporting instructor-led training, workforce development, learning services, or blended learning programs.
* Experience managing a portfolio of customer relationships and competing priorities.
* Experience delivering presentations, webinars, enablement sessions, and business reviews while coordinating across customer stakeholders and internal teams.
* Experience utilizing Salesforce and customer success platforms to manage customer engagement and lifecycle activities.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Data analysis, customer storytelling, and business outcome communication.
* Customer success planning and value realization.
* Strong stakeholder management, relationship-building, communication, and presentation skills.
* Program and project coordination.
* Experience leveraging Salesforce and customer success technologies.
* Strong organizational, time-management, and portfolio management skills.

**Why Join QA?**

Join QA and help shape the future of work for some of the world's most recognized organizations. Partner with leaders across technology, learning, and business functions to help customers close capability gaps, accelerate workforce transformation, and achieve measurable business outcomes.

You will act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, driving measurable business outcomes, product adoption, retention, and expansion across complex, multi-threaded enterprise accounts.

  + Partner with internal teams to secure customer referrals, testimonials, and event speakers

  + Serve as the voice of the customer internally, influencing Product, Support, and Services
  + Coordinate internal resources to deliver a seamless, high-quality enterprise customer experience

* ChurnZero experience is a plus
* Knowledge of the CPG industry is strongly preferred
* High degree of comfort with technology, particularly databases and syndicated data
* Strong presentation skills with the ability to communicate value and insights to professional and executive audiences

* Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve customer challenges
* Demonstrated success working with both large, complex enterprises and mid-sized organizations

---------------------------------

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating. Sales Representative must be enthusiastic and goal-driven member to drive business in the areas of boat rentals, yacht rentals and maritime software sales. The representative will also work with the Business Development Manager to identify target companies and markets for leasing retro boats and pontoon boats to proven operators.

**Schedule**

* Monday – Friday plus some weekend hours during high season.
* Travel may be necessary for in-person presentations. All travel to be approved by Business Development or President.

**Responsibilities**

*1. Sales Strategy:*

* Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to achieve or surpass sales targets for our boat rental, leasing, and dockage software (GoDock), properly applying differentiated focus at different times of year.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, and market analysis.
* Document and maintain CRM hygiene for all prospecting and active clients.
* Attend industry conferences and shows as directed by the Business Development Manager or President.

*2. Client Relationship Management:*

* Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with new clients, understand their evolving needs, and ensure high satisfaction levels.
* Provide personalized software demonstrations to potential clients, effectively communicating how our solutions can address their specific requirements.
* Maintain a high level of touchpoints and follow up with all opportunities in CRM.

* Stay well-versed in the various options, as there are multiple areas of focus.

* Collaborate with marketing to develop compelling sales collateral, presentations, and materials that accurately represent the features and benefits of our comprehensive software solutions.

*6. Pipeline Management:*

* Maintain a well-organized sales pipeline, offering regular updates on progress and forecasting future sales.
* Utilize CRM tools to track leads, opportunities, sales, and client interactions.

*7. Market Intelligence:*

* Stay informed about industry trends, competitor offerings, and market demands to contribute insights for product development and refine sales strategies.

**Prerequisites:**

* Proven sales experience, preferably within the maritime industry.
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to comprehend and effectively communicate the value of software solutions.
* Goal-oriented with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

* Self-motivated and capable of working independently.

Submit your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and what excites you about this opportunity. We look forward to learning more about you!

Pay: From $48,000.00 per year

Benefits:

**Autonomy and ownership**  
Manage your own territory and build a book of business with the flexibility of a field-based sales role.

**High-visibility, results-driven role**  
Your performance directly contributes to revenue growth and market expansion within the personal injury segment.

**Professional growth**  
Develop expertise in healthcare sales, referral development, and territory strategy within a high-growth organization.

**Collaborative support**  
Partner with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery and a strong client experience.

### **You’re a Strong Fit If You Have**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***

The Executive Assistant serves as a trusted and highly proactive partner to one or more C-level executives at AHEAD. By protecting executive time, anticipating needs, organizing competing priorities, and driving follow-through, this role creates the leverage needed to focus on the highest-value work. * Develop a strong understanding of each executive’s priorities, working style, relationships, and decision-making preferences.
* Anticipate needs, identify risks, and recommend solutions before issues become urgent.
* Triage competing requests by determining what requires two or more executives’ attention, what can be delegated, and what should be deferred.
* Maintain visibility into open commitments, decisions, and follow-up items, and drive accountability through completion.

**Calendar and meeting leadership**

* Own the complex and dynamic calendars of multiple executives, balancing strategic priorities, internal operating rhythms, client and partner commitments, travel, and personal focus time.

* Prepare the relevant executive for meetings by gathering background information, briefing materials, agendas, talking points, and relevant decisions or action items.
* Capture and distribute action items as appropriate, ensuring that decisions and next steps are documented and advanced.

**Communications and information flow**

* Communicate on behalf of the executive in a tone that is clear, thoughtful, responsive, and aligned with AHEAD’s standards.
* Monitor executive inboxes and incoming requests with sound judgment, confidentiality, and an understanding of organizational context.
* When required to draft, edit, and proofread correspondence, presentations, meeting materials, and other communications in the appropriate executive’s voice.
* Provide timely updates on emerging issues, organizational developments, upcoming commitments, and decisions requiring attention.

**Travel, expenses, and logistics**

* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including air, hotel, ground transportation, itineraries, changes, and travel-related materials.
* Manage expense reporting and related approvals accurately and on time.
* Own end-to-end logistics for executive meetings, offsites, and events, including:

* + Room selection, setup, and AV or virtual platform readiness

  + On-site hosting of guests, including greeting, directions, and parking or access
  + Post-meeting cleanup and room reset, stepping in personally when needed

**Special projects and executive operations**

* Create practical systems, templates, and operating rhythms that improve executive effectiveness and reduce friction.
* Partner with other Executive Assistants and cross-functional teams to coordinate coverage, improve processes, and provide consistent executive experience.
* Support preparation for senior leadership, board, advisory, and client-facing engagements as assigned.
* Handle sensitive information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.

**Office Presence, Availability, and Responsiveness**

* Work in the office 4-5 days per week. An in-person presence is required when the executive(s) you support are in the office, when the office administrator needs backup coverage, as well as key meetings and events.
* Treat the role as a 24/7 executive support position, remaining available and attentive beyond standard business hours.
* Always respond promptly to time-sensitive needs.
* Anticipate what the supported executives may need before they ask.

new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
As a Revenue Operations Specialist reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations, you'll play a critical role in designing and optimizing the commercial processes, systems, and operating models that power Nasdaq's revenue lifecycle — from lead generation through to customer renewal.  
  
You'll thrive in this role if you're analytical, collaborative, and solutions-oriented, with a passion for translating complex business needs into scalable, technology-enabled processes that drive measurable commercial outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and optimize end-to-end revenue processes — spanning lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-contract, onboarding, renewal, and customer lifecycle workflows — to improve efficiency, predictability, and scale.
* Lead discovery sessions with cross-functional stakeholders to assess current-state processes, define business requirements, and build future-state operating models.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business teams and technical delivery partners, ensuring requirements are accurately translated into implemented solutions.
* Leverage data, analytics, and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities, quantify business impact, and influence decisions across sales, marketing, finance, and technology.
* Lead small to medium-sized cross-functional initiatives, driving adoption of new processes, tools, and operating models through effective change management and stakeholder engagement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education and/or relevant experience - MBA or advanced degree preferred; relevant internships and professional experience valued
* 2–5+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, or a related commercial or business operations function.
* Strong understanding of commercial technology ecosystems, including platforms supporting sales, marketing automation, customer success, and revenue intelligence.
* Proven ability to use analytics and business intelligence tools to identify revenue risks and opportunities and develop actionable recommendations.
* Excellent communicator with experience working across matrixed, global environments and influencing both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience evaluating or implementing AI-enabled solutions, workflow automation, or predictive tools to improve commercial execution.
* Familiarity with forecasting, pipeline management, and revenue performance management processes.
* Exposure to global teams and cross-border collaboration.

This position will be located in **Atlanta** and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment at least **3 days** a week in-office, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates.

**Come as You Are**

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

**What We Offer**

We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package that is meaningful, recognizes the unique needs of our employees and their families and incentivizes employees for their contribution to Nasdaq’s overall success.

In addition to base salary, Nasdaq offers significant other compensation (annual bonus/commissions and equity), benefits, and opportunity for growth. Exact compensation may vary based on several job-related factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, experience, education/training, business needs and market demands.

Nasdaq’s programs and rewards are intended to allow our employees to:

* **Secure Wealth:** 401(k) program with 6% employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Program with 15% discount, Student loan repayment program up to $10k, Company paid life and disability plans, Generous paid time off
* **Prioritize Health:** Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, Health spending account with employer contribution, Paid flex days to support mental wellbeing, Gym membership discounts
* **Care for Family**: Hybrid home/office schedule (for most positions), Paid parental leave, Fertility benefits, Paid bereavement leave
* **Connect with Community:** Company gift matching program, Employee resource groups, Paid volunteer days
* **Grow Career:** Education Assistance Program, Robust job skills training and Professional development opportunities

**Connell Commons - Atlanta, GA**

Woda Cooper Companies, Inc**.** is a rapidly growing development, construction, and property management organization dedicated to the creation of quality affordable housing to benefit those who need it most. We are an employee-owned, passion-driven group that changes each community of which we are a part. We manage over 16,000 housing units in 19 states, proudly serving seniors, veterans, and other economically challenged groups. We seek ambitious, talented individuals who want to grow with a rapidly expanding company whose success is not only measured in dollars and cents, but in lives changed. **WHERE YOU'LL WORK:**

Connell Commons is a 144-unit affordable housing community located in Atlanta, Georgia, featuring six three-story residential buildings and a variety of resident amenities, including a clubhouse, community room, business center, playground, and outdoor gathering spaces. As the Community Manager, you'll oversee the day-to-day operations of the community, including resident relations, leasing, compliance, financial performance, and property operations. Working closely with residents, vendors, and your regional support team, you'll help maintain a safe, welcoming, and well-managed community while delivering exceptional customer service and supporting Woda Cooper's commitment to providing quality affordable housing.

* Maintain confidentiality at all times related to prospect or resident information.
* Maintain secure handling of rents and all monies on site, daily deposits and record keeping.

* Outgoing, friendly, and customer-oriented demeanor.

TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  
  
TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.  
  
**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at TriNet you will serve as the face of a well established, reputable company that empowers the small business community to focus on what matters most – growing their business. This individual is often the first line of communication between TriNet and prospective clients as the person responsible for identifying, contacting and qualifying opportunities for the sales organization to generate new business. This role, coupled with TriNet emphasis on continuous learning and defined career paths, will lay the foundation for a successful sales career. If you are somebody looking to accelerate your sales development career with a high growth, stable company and rewarding mission, then come join us!  
  
**What you will do**

* Secure meetings with the right people, at the right place, at the right time to create high quality sales opportunities for the field sales team.
* The focus each day for our SDRs is getting connected with decision makers, extending the conversation, and securing meetings for our field sales team.
* Use internal sales tools and resources to execute a high touch sales cadence on prospects.
* Make around 80 cold calls a day to prospects to gauge interest.
* Initiate contact with prospects through a multi-channel outbound prospecting strategy using phone calls, email, and LinkedIn.
* Attend meetings you’ve scheduled and conduct routine check-ins with your Sales Consultant to receive feedback on the opportunities you have created.
* Execute a follow-up strategy on prospects that were not interested but maybe in the future or were interested but did not buy.
* Develop new sales strategies based on personal successes and failures and share what’s working with your peers!
* Performs other duties as assigned
* Complies with all policies and standards

**Education Qualifications**

* High School Diploma required or
* Bachelor's Degree preferred

**Experience Qualifications**

* Typically < 1 year Sales prospecting and research preferred

**Skills and Abilities**

* Articulate and persuasive written and oral communicator (Intermediate proficiency)
* Demonstrate willingness to grow through discomfort – fearless! (Intermediate proficiency)
* Seeks out, internalizes, and applies coaching feedback (Intermediate proficiency)
* Strong work ethic and self-drive (Intermediate proficiency)
* A believer in the fruits of a disciplined process (Intermediate proficiency)
* Strong attention to detail and highly organized (Intermediate proficiency)
* Great active-listening skills (Intermediate proficiency)
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude in the face of rejection and failure (Intermediate proficiency)
* Enjoys collaborating with internal and cross-functional teams (Intermediate proficiency)
* Strong computer literacy skills (Intermediate proficiency)
* Experience using a CRM; Salesforce preferred (Intermediate proficiency)
* A demonstrated commitment to high professional ethical standards and a diverse workplace (Intermediate proficiency)

**Travel Requirements**  
Minimal

* Work in clean, pleasant, and comfortable office or home setting.
